thread:
Bea (partnerships): quick sync: we're rolling a small but breaking response-envelope change to Partner API responses — adding `trace_id` at the top level and moving `model.output` into `response.payload`. This will affect some partner SDKs and marketplace connectors that do shallow parsing. Target enforcement: 2025-09-10. 6-week runway. Need partner preview, SDK patches, marketplace listing updates, and SI playbooks.
Tom (eng): technical note: old response shape: `{id, model, output}`. new: `{id, trace_id, response: {payload: {model, output}, meta}}`. We'll serve both shapes during runway if `Accept: application/vnd.redwood.compat=1` header present. No behavior change to model outputs, just envelope.
Rachael (product): we should include an explicit compatibility flag in the SDKs and a migration guide. Recommend partner-only preview week before public docs. Also coordinate marketplace vendor banner and marketplace connector validations.
Hector (legal): checking partner contracts for schema-change notice obligations. Most partners expect 30 days but enterprise SLAs may require escalation. I'll confirm by EOD.
Nina (platform): runtime plan: gateway will accept both shapes when header present and log `resp_envelope_deprecated` events. Canary in europe-west first. We'll also emit `X-RW-Trace: present` header when trace_id included. Ops runbook RNW-ops-310 created for rollbacks.
Elena (devex): I'll ship small SDK patches that expose `response.payload` transparently while keeping `response.output` at top level for backwards compat via a getter. plan: js-sdk v2.1.1, python-sdk v3.0.2. Will also publish a compatibility shim package `@redwood/envelope-compat` that partners can drop-in. ETA Aug 18 for prerelease.
VendorLiaisonBot: @Bea created issue RNW-5322 "Partner API response envelope: add trace_id + move payload" https://issues.redwood.ai/RNW-5322
Tom (eng): telemetry: we'll add `deprecated_envelope_seen` and a daily list of partner app ids hitting the deprecated shape. Also provide a small test harness partners can run against sandbox to validate parsing.
Bea (partnerships): action list: Partnerships to notify top 25 partners + marketplace vendors on Aug 20. Rachael to draft partner FAQ + migration checklist by Aug 12. Elena to publish shim prerelease by Aug 18. Nina to enable gateway compat canary Aug 25. Hector to confirm legal notice timing by Aug 8. Tom to add telemetry dashboard Aug 15.
Rachael (product): draft FAQ posted: http://go/redwood/partner-envelope-faq 6 includes sample diffs, SI runbook pointers, and a table of SDK versions with compat status. Please review.
Elena (devex): shim example (JS): `const compat = require('@redwood/envelope-compat'); app.use(compat({preserveTopLevel:true})); // adds getters so old code keeps working` will also publish Dockerized shim for partners running on-prem.
Nina (platform): canary plan: enable europe-west Aug 25, us-east Sep 1, marketplace connector tests Sep 4, global Sep 8. Enforcement Sep 10 -> gateway returns 410 for deprecated envelope unless `Accept` header or shim used.
Hector (legal): enterprise customers flagged: two marketplace SI partners that bundle our responses into their own XML payloads. we'll need targeted comms + a joint test window. I'll coordinate legal + partnerships outreach.
Tom (eng): compatibility note: some hardware partners (edge devices) parse without JSON libs; recommend we provide a raw binary-safe example and a tiny C helper that extracts `output` by path. Devex to own.
Elena (devex): will add C and Go tiny helpers to repo and a migration CLI `rw-envelopes-check` to scan responses. Webinar planned Aug 28 for partners and SIs.
Bea (partnerships): timeline summary: Aug 8 legal ok, Aug 12 FAQ, Aug 18 shim prerelease, Aug 20 partner/vendor ping + sandbox access, Aug 25 canary europe-west, Sep 1 canary us-east, Sep 4 marketplace integration tests, Sep 8 global rollout, Sep 10 enforcement.
Tom (eng): will tag RNW-5322 with owners and add the daily partner impact export for outreach.
Rachael (product): owners: partnerships=Bea, eng=Tom, devex=Elena, platform=Nina, legal=Hector, docs=Rachael, marketplace=Ava (assigning). Everyone pls update RNW-5322 with owner + ETA.
Bea (partnerships): thanks team. Partnerships will prepare escalation matrix for the top 10 SIs and marketplace vendors and schedule follow-ups. :thumbsup:
All: :thumbsup:
